lines.text: R. COMMUTER wants to buy some flowers, plants and other things for his garden, and here we see him at the seed store puzzling out what to buy. Can you hep him? The list of articles on sale is in anagram form; that is, the letters spelling the name of each article have been rearranged to spell something else. For instance, SEE SAW PET can be recast to spell SWEET PEAS. Can you figure out the names of the other twelve articles in the list?
